gaps.explanation: Printed rounding in the report itself (no extraction error): p4 Property row Total column 179,996 vs General 167,427 + Street 12,570 = 179,997 (+1); p10 General Fund department rows add 1 over their printed Total column: State assistance 33,542+60,845+18,050+1,508+56,982+16,243 = 187,170 vs 187,169 (+1), Interest income 939+2,253+765+55 = 4,012 vs 4,011 (+1), Other revenues 237,029+927+9,570+186+150 = 247,862 vs 247,861 (+1). 1+1+1+1 = 4 = gap (schedule 798,330 vs statement 798,326). Detail lines are as printed; no fix.

The General Fund departments schedule (p10) prints 'Transfer out' 97,518 (General 91,518 + Parks 6,000) inside Total Expenditures 1,215,157, and the statement (p4) carries the same 1,215,157 in its General column, so General government 332,849 includes 91,518 and Environment and leisure 99,960 includes 6,000. Detail records the 97,518 as Transfers Out (other financing, printed_in expenditure). 1,321,503 - 97,518 = 1,223,985; detail 1,223,987 is 2 higher from p10 rounding (department line items add to 1,215,159 vs printed 1,215,157: General column 673,109 vs 673,108, Library 13,786 vs 13,785, Museum 2,979 vs 2,980, plus the department totals add to 1,215,158). 97,518 - 2 = 97,516 = gap. No fix (adding expenditure lines would double count the transfer lines).

Statement p4 prints only net 'Transfers in (out)' (40,468) = transfer in 57,050 - transfer out 97,518 (General column). Schedule p10 prints them gross: Transfer in 57,050 (General) among revenues and Transfer out 91,518 (General) + 6,000 (Parks) = 97,518 among expenditures; detail records Transfers Out -97,518 and Transfers In 57,050. 97,518 - 40,468 = 57,050 = gap. No fix.
